title: Unsolicited Political Communications Legislation Amendment Bill 2021
short_title: Unsolicited Political Communications Legislation Amendment Bill 2021

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change federal electoral and spam laws to require unsubscribe options for political electronic messages and identify actors used in political telephone campaigns.
Electronic communications containing federal electoral matter would need an opt-out facility regardless of commercial purpose, while actors portraying people would be identified when calls began.
The measures would apply from the twenty-eighth day after royal assent and regulate how political messages were delivered to voters by individuals and organisations.
changes: Senders of political electronic messages would have to include a working unsubscribe option for recipients.
Actors performing as people in particular occupations or circumstances during electoral calls would have to be identified.
Spam legislation provisions referring to commercial electronic messages would be extended to capture political electronic messages.
summary.affected: Voters, political parties, candidates, other political message senders and campaign actors would be affected.
